process: Lignin removal, eucalyptus pulp mill (Sect. 4.2.1, Table 7)
value: LignoBoost-type lignin precipitation: black liquor at 30-45% dry solids from the evaporators is acidified with CO2 to precipitate lignin, which is press-filtered, re-slurried and conditioned with sulphuric acid, filtered again, with filtrates returned to evaporation; used to debottleneck overloaded recovery boilers and give a high-energy-density low-ash solid biofuel.

process: Black liquor gasification, Chemrec (Sect. 4.2.2)
value: Chemrec entrained-flow black liquor gasifier: liquor and oxygen fed at the top of the reactor at slightly above 1000 degC with about 5 s residence time, quench cooler separating green-liquor smelt, counter-current gas cooler and H2S absorption; syngas can make DME or methane instead of recovery-boiler steam.

process: Black liquor gasification, Chemrec (Sect. 4.2.2)

process: Biomass gasification for lime kiln fuel (Sect. 4.1.4)

process: Biomass gasification for lime kiln fuel (Sect. 4.1.4)

process: Torrefaction (Sect. 4.1.2)
value: Heating biomass at 220-300 degC without oxygen, removing moisture and degrading hemicellulose to give a brittle, hydrophobic, energy-dense solid fuel; torrefaction gases are burnt in an afterburner to heat the drying and torrefaction.
